description: Image Description: The image displays a close-up view of a plated meal consisting of several roasted vegetables and a side of bread. In the foreground, there are slices of yellow squash (likely zucchini or summer squash) that have been roasted to a golden-brown color, with visible seasoning such as herbs and possibly black pepper. Interspersed among the squash are roasted Brussels sprouts, some of which appear slightly charred, indicating they were cooked at a high temperature. Scattered throughout the dish
